derived_from: his 1-10-8-40 bank (3,204 rows) split on his ruling: every ID holding two or three meanings becomes separate IDs. The source bank is NOT modified.
law: REPLACE, NEVER DELETE — the source registry stands untouched beside this.
Every node carries a human column and a computer column.
Steps 1-8 are first order and close to step 1. Steps 9-12 are the life of the loop itself and 11-12 can fire at any step.

spine.name: GROUND
spine.line: The thing is already there. Nobody made it.
spine.human: Fuel exists — earth, land, water, seeds, season — before any stomach.
spine.computer: Bare-metal state before execution: ROM, microcode, ACPI tables, idle voltage rails.
intent_types: IT-01 DISPOSITION — the act flows from what the actor IS

spine.name: PRESSURE
spine.human: The body empties. Contact is forced; hunger is felt.
spine.computer: Edge-triggered interrupts, thermal trips, low-voltage alarms, buffer-full asserts.
intent_types: IT-02 AFFORDANCE — the moment offered it
IT-07 IMPATIENCE / VISIBLE PROOF — cannot hold through the long invisible process

spine.name: USE
spine.line: It is used long before it is understood.
spine.human: Humanity eats and farms for millennia before anyone can say what food is.
spine.computer: Compiled binaries, DMA transfers, PID servo loops, L1 cache hits — running, unexamined.
intent_types: IT-03 AUTOMATICITY — ran with no live reason at all

spine.name: WITNESS
spine.line: Someone stops using it and looks at it. Rare, and a choice.
spine.human: Someone looks at eating itself: why does the body demand this?
spine.computer: Breakpoints, profilers, hypervisor hooks, stack traces — execution frozen and inspected.
intent_types: IT-09 PERMISSION-WAITING — stalled on a permission never asked for

spine.name: EXPRESSION
spine.line: A way to say it is found. This — not step 1 — is the human act.
spine.human: 'Fuel for the body.' Calories. Metabolism. F = G·m1m2/r².
spine.computer: Serialization: tensors, ASTs, JSON schemas, coordinate transforms, protocol buffers.

spine.name: NAMING
spine.line: The name stands for the thing. THIS IS WHERE THE MASK FORMS.
spine.human: 'Hunger' becomes the word — and hides that there are many hungers. MASK.
spine.computer: Primary keys, strict types, frozen enums, token vocabularies — the label replaces the thing.
intent_types: IT-06 ROLE / VIRTUE BINDING — compelled by the actor's own standing

spine.name: HALT
spine.line: The expression fails somewhere. There is always a somewhere.
spine.human: 'Hunger = need for food' fails on the other hungers. Mercury's orbit disobeys Newton.
spine.computer: NullPointer, segfault, OOM, divide-by-zero, PID saturation, out-of-vocabulary token.
intent_types: IT-04 OVERRIDE BY A HIGHER CLAIM — a larger obligation outranked the rule

spine.name: LOOP
spine.line: The halt becomes the next GROUND.
spine.human: Each unquieted hunger is a new ground. The halt becomes Einstein's ground.
spine.computer: Backpropagation, weight updates, write-ahead commits, hot config reload.
intent_types: IT-05 RECOVERY — acting to restore what is already lost
IT-08 FRUIT-FOCUS — acting for the reward, not the rightness of the act

spine.name: CONSOLIDATION
spine.line: Many cycles harden into permanent architecture.
spine.human: Long-term potentiation; hippocampal-to-cortical offloading during deep sleep.
spine.computer: Quantization, LoRA weight freezing, index compaction, static library linking.

spine.name: ALIENATION
spine.line: The Mask is mistaken for Ground. The history decays.
spine.human: Functional fixedness, confirmation bias, synaptic pruning, trace decay.
spine.computer: Bit rot, LRU/LFU cache eviction, log truncation, deprecated endpoints, OOV drops.

spine.name: COLLISION
spine.line: The system hits another system. The individual boundary breaks.
spine.human: Theory of mind, mirror neurons, enculturation, collective memory.
spine.computer: Raft/Paxos consensus, gRPC arbitration, message brokers, federated weight merges.

spine.name: METAMORPHOSIS
spine.line: The framework itself breaks to build a new paradigm.
spine.human: Conceptual blending, paradigm shift, epigenetic restructuring, speciation.
spine.computer: Self-rewriting compilers, monolith-to-serverless migration, evolutionary opcode search.
